title: Add API facade and remove remaining layer-first shims
summary: Introduce/finish src/api/** and src/shared/** facades, move primitive shared ports/helpers, and remove residual src/domain/** and src/application/** owner paths after concept roots land.

goal.outcome: Stable API/shared facade exists and residual layer-first owner paths are removed or explicitly documented as temporary compatibility shims with guard coverage.
acceptance: Create or finish src/api/** facade modules that expose stable package/tool use-case entrypoints for adapters/scripts while keeping adapters/UI as exposure layers.
Move primitive shared types/utils/ports/session-independent helpers to src/shared/** and keep shared small; no dumping-ground replacement for application/domain is created.
Update adapters, scripts, tests, and package smoke to import concept behavior through src/api/**, concept roots, or src/shared/** as appropriate.
Remove residual src/domain/** and src/application/** owner paths after previous concept-root tasks land, or retain only explicit temporary shims with expiry, owner, and tests.
Update file-structure KB/diagram and architecture checks to mark concept-root migration complete and fail on reintroduced old owner paths unless explicitly approved.
Add final guard proving no unapproved src/domain/** or src/application/** owner imports remain and package entrypoints/direct Node execution still load.
non_goals: Do not redesign public package API or user-facing tool schemas beyond import/facade preservation.
Do not migrate adapters, UI, skills, tests, or scripts into concept roots; they remain exposure/assets/tests/helper layers.
Do not create top-level infrastructure/core/engine roots or broad shared dumping grounds.
